chapter_title: Chương 151: Lan truyền mạnh mẽ, nền tảng Youke Huyu ra mắt

segments.title: Chương 151: Lan truyền mạnh mẽ, nền tảng Youke Huyu ra mắt
segments.content:
Shencheng.

QQ Zone, which was still in closed beta, had a dedicated team member keeping an eye on Xiaonei.com.

The next day, as soon as Zheng Zhiwu arrived at the company, the person on surveillance duty came to report: "Xiaonei.com has launched a mini-game called 'Happy Farm,' and it's incredibly, incredibly popular. Last night, a lot of users stayed up late to steal vegetables!"

"Steal vegetables?" Although Zheng Zhiwu didn't quite understand, he could guess it was a gameplay mechanic.

He quickly went to the computer.

Xiaonei.com used a real-name registration system, requiring students to submit their student ID numbers, but the company couldn't perfectly verify their identities.

If a student from a certain class at a certain school discovered that someone in their class was an imposter, they could initiate a class-wide vote to report them and request to have that person kicked out.

If the class vote exceeded two-thirds, Xiaonei.com would forcibly delete the account.

The QQ Zone team had previously registered two accounts randomly, and both were forcibly deleted within three days. To deal with this, they specially brought in an intern to experience Xiaonei.com using the intern's real account.

After playing for over ten minutes, Zheng Zhiwu said, bewildered, "How can a game like this get popular? I'm not interested in it at all."

The intern stood beside him. "It blew up last night, spreading like a virus. At least half of my classmates are playing it. Some people were even too lazy to keep watch, so they stayed up all night writing cheat programs to automatically harvest vegetables."

"That crazy?" Zheng Zhiwu found it hard to believe.

The intern said, "The academic representative of our class, who never used to play games, got up in the middle of the night to steal vegetables."

Zheng Zhiwu fell silent.

He was also an "Extradimensional Demon" who had recently joined Tencent and wasn't very familiar with the leaders of other departments. On top of that, Tencent was undergoing a corporate restructuring, and management was a bit chaotic.

If "Happy Farm" was really that amazing, then QQ could completely rip it off. But that would have nothing to do with QQ Zone. It would definitely be handed over to the gaming department, so what business was it of his, Zheng Zhiwu?

Tencent had ventured into the online gaming industry two years prior, acting as the agent for a Korean game called "Triumph." It was quite popular at first, but the servers were often laggy, the payment model was chaotic, and they were slow to handle bugs and cheats. Now, it was barely alive.

Currently, Tencent only had "QQ Tang," a knockoff of the most popular casual game, "Bomb and Bubbles."

There was also "QQ Fantasy," which was still in closed beta.

The rest were card and board games, like Fight the Landlord and Mahjong.

Zheng Zhiwu said, "Keep an eye on it. If 'Happy Farm' continues to be this popular, I'll submit a report to the higher-ups to bring it to their attention."

What Zheng Zhiwu was really thinking was: If "Happy Farm" is truly that great, it's a huge waste for Xiaonei.com to be operating it, since only college students have access. If QQ were to do it, it could become a game for the entire nation!

Would a person like Chen Guiliang, who makes the most of everything, let "Happy Farm" just sit on Xiaonei.com and wait for other companies to copy it?

Around noon, Zheng Zhiwu received another report: "Xiaonei.com's 'Happy Farm' is driving traffic to a gaming platform!"

"What gaming platform?" Zheng Zhiwu asked.

"Youke Interactive Entertainment. It only has four games at the moment: one client-based game, 'Sanguosha'; one web game, 'Happy Farm'; and two Flash games, 'Tetris' and 'Incredible Miner.' That 'Incredible Miner' is pretty much the same as 4399's 'Gold Miner'."

"A bit of a mishmash."

"This Youke Interactive Entertainment also has a forum section to encourage players to interact. As long as you register one account, you can play all the games on the site without needing to register again. Player accounts can also add each other as friends. They even encourage users to create and upload Flash games, paying creators in Youke site currency based on the number of plays."

"This Chen Guiliang is really ambitious. He's finally showing his fangs!"

Flash games were a product of a specific era.

At this time, limited by technology and internet speeds, web games had many restrictions. For example, it wasn't convenient to make "Sanguosha" into a web game. To give players a better experience, it could only be made as a client-based version.

Flash games, on the other hand, were embedded into web pages as .swf files, and users only needed to install the Flash Player plugin to play. They served as an early substitute for web games.

At this time, 4399 was entirely composed of Flash mini-games.

Of course, Flash games couldn't be made too complex. Porting over simple NES games from the early days was just right.

Moreover, they were extremely simple and cheap to produce.

For instance, when Chen Guiliang had Game Science create a Flash version of Tetris, Dong Qianqiu outsourced the programming, art, and sound effects. The total development cost for the outsourcing was only 1000 yuan. All the programmers at Game Science had to do was test for compatibility and bugs.

Luo Bingjie was a sophomore girl at Zhengzhou University. She had never played computer games before.

She logged onto Xiaonei.com last night to keep up with a serial novel. The novel she liked hadn't been selected as the official version for the story relay, but she felt it was more touching than the official version.

Because of this, she even joined a group to discuss the novel, planning out the subsequent plot with the author every day.

She felt a great sense of participation!

She also particularly loved "The Wind Rises," as if it were the custom theme song for this novel.

Of course, readers who liked other novels also felt that "The Wind Rises" was the theme song for the stories they were following.

The lyrics of "The Wind Rises" were written very vaguely, so they could be applied to all sorts of youth romance novels!

Last night, several friends from the novel discussion group recommended "Happy Farm" to Luo Bingjie. Although she didn't like playing games, she had to save face for her friends, so she started playing in a daze.

But then, Luo Bingjie discovered that these friends who invited her to play "Happy Farm" weren't sharing the game out of kindness. It was so they could steal the vegetables she had worked so hard to grow!

Those bastards.

Before she even had a chance to react, her first batch of vegetables had been completely stolen by those rotten friends.

The afternoon class had just begun when Luo Bingjie sprinted towards her dorm, and she wasn't the only student running with her.

The teacher stood at the podium and asked curiously, "Is there some kind of school event?"

A student laughed and said, "We have to rush back to harvest our vegetables."

"Harvest vegetables?" The teacher was completely bewildered.

Back in the dorm, she opened her computer.

Luo Bingjie looked at her farm and roared in anguish, "Ahhhhh... It's all been stolen! I want to kill someone!"

As she planted vegetables again, she discovered the quest system:

"Dear 'Happy Farm' player, to let more people enjoy the fun of harvesting (and having their vegetables stolen), you can help with promotional quests."

"'Happy Farm' has been launched on Guijie Interactive Entertainment. You can generate ten invitation codes daily to invite your real-life friends to register for a Guijie account. For every person who registers on Guijie Interactive Entertainment, you will receive two sets of Golden Apple Seeds on Xiaonei.com's 'Happy Farm.' Remember, the same IP address can only help you complete the quest a maximum of three times on Guijie."

Zheng Zhiwu clicked to view the "Golden Apple Seeds," and his eyes instantly lit up.

This item was not for sale; it could only be obtained by completing quests.

She read the quest prompt, quickly followed the quest link to the Guijie Interactive Entertainment webpage. Then, using her own invitation codes, she directly registered three accounts and immediately returned to Xiaonei.com to claim her six sets of Golden Apple Seeds.

She could continue to register more alternate accounts on Guijie, but because the IP address was the same, she couldn't claim any more quest rewards later on.

Luo Bingjie hurriedly recommended it to a few of her friends on Xiaonei.com, but the replies she got were:

"Why is someone else recommending this again? So annoying."

"I've already registered. You're too late!"

"Don't have time today."

After thinking for a moment, she logged onto QQ and contacted her old high school classmates.

After asking around, she only managed to give out five invitation codes.

There were still the last two left.

She picked up her phone and dialed her home landline. Her mom answered, "Hello, Mom... Yeah, I'm doing well at school. It's not that I'm out of living expenses... Okay, okay, okay. Is my brother home? Oh, he's back from school. Can you put him on the phone for a sec?"

Then she lowered her voice, "Hey, lil' bro, don't be loud... I'm recommending a super fun game to you. It won't take up your study time... Yeah, log into QQ, I'll send you the invitation code and website... Remember, don't let Mom and Dad find out."

After hanging up, Luo Bingjie remembered something else.

She planted the seeds in "Happy Farm" on Xiaonei.com, then went to log into "Happy Farm" on Guijie Interactive Entertainment. Her four accounts, Luo Bingjie and three alternates, added each other as friends. All of them could plant vegetables and steal from each other.

Haha, now I have five farms! I'm such a little genius!

Luo Bingjie's brother was still in middle school this year. He was baffled when he got his sister's call.

His sister doesn't play games.

While his mom was cooking and his dad wasn't home for lunch, he secretly slipped into his parents' room and turned on the computer.

Using the website and invitation code his sister gave him, Luo Bingjie's brother registered an account on Guijie Interactive Entertainment, then entered "Happy Farm" to plant, fertilize, and water his crops.

After that, not knowing what to do, Luo Bingjie's brother wandered over to Guijie's forums and found it was full of new users all posting the same thing: asking to add friends.

Luo Bingjie's brother went and added a few friends. One of them told him that "Sanguosha" was really fun, so he clicked to download "Sanguosha." It was a game he had never heard of before.

The internet speed was too slow; it wouldn't be done for a while.

Luo Bingjie's brother discovered that his Guijie account could also generate invitation codes, and he could get quest rewards by inviting friends.

He tiptoed to the landline and called his classmate's house, "Hello, Uncle You, this is Luo Bingjie's brother... I have a math problem I'd like to ask your son You Hao about... Yes, could you please put him on the phone..."

"You Hao? Keep your voice down... I'll tell you about a super fun game..."

After making a few calls, his mom called him for lunch.

"Coming! I'm just looking up some study materials on the computer!"

Luo Bingjie's brother spouted some nonsense, ran back to his parents' room, and sat in front of the computer, soon finding himself dumbfounded.

His first batch of crops to mature had already been stolen, leaving him with only the bare minimum!

Frustrated, Luo Bingjie's brother went to the farms of those friends he had randomly added. Finally, he saw a plot of land with mature crops that hadn't been harvested yet.

Haha, I got to steal some too.

"Hurry up and eat!" His mom was standing at the door, who knows for how long.

Luo Bingjie's brother was scared out of his wits and frantically tried to close the webpage.

His mom thought he was browsing porn sites and scolded, "Open the webpage you just closed!"

Luo Bingjie's brother braced himself, opened the webpage, and explained, "Mom, I wasn't looking at anything unhealthy, just playing a mini-game. This game doesn't take up time. It's just planting, harvesting, and stealing vegetables."

His mom had a look of disbelief on her face.

Luo Bingjie's brother stood up and offered his seat, "If you don't believe me, try it yourself."

After his mom sat down, she didn't play the game. Instead, she checked the browser history. Her husband had taught her this trick, specifically to handle their kid.

Finding that he indeed hadn't been browsing any porn sites, his mom finally relaxed.

Luo Bingjie's brother said, "Mom, this game is actually pretty fun. I'll help you register an account, and you can even go to the forums to add friends. This is my invitation code. I'll send it to you so you can do a quest... Just register like this and then you can play... This is the shop, but you don't need to top up. You can get regular seeds and premium fertilizer for free every day..."

Under her son's guidance, his mother got more and more into the game. Soon, she snapped back to reality and said, "Hurry up and eat. After you eat, get to school early!"

"Oh." Luo Bingjie's brother left silently.

His mom, however, was having a blast. She even copied down the invitation code she generated and the URL for Guijie Interactive Entertainment.

In the afternoon, at her company.

This mother said to her colleague, "Youke, there's a super fun online game. I can give you an invitation code to register an account."

"You play online games?" Youke had a look on her face like she'd seen a ghost.

The mother said, "Really, it's super fun. When I get home tonight, I'm going to recommend it to my Old Luo... You should try it, it's free."

"It's really free?" Youke inquired.

"You can spend money, but you can also play without spending money."

"Alright, I'll give it a try then."

Another middle-aged mom was pulled into the fray.

That night, the Luo couple played the game for a while before going to sleep.

In the middle of the night, the husband secretly got out of bed, turned on the computer, and stole his wife's vegetables.

Then, pretending nothing had happened, he went back to bed and continued to snore away.
